name: l1000_tahoe_agreement_summary
claim: Noise ceiling, direction and magnitude for L1000 vs Tahoe deltas on 32 shared (cell line, drug) pairs, 978 landmark genes. L1000 split-half reproducibility 0.5721 [95% CI 0.4885, 0.6557] -- L1000's own delta IS reproducible, so the near-zero cross-platform agreement (0.0410 [0.0054, 0.0766]) is genuine platform disagreement and NOT L1000 measurement noise. Sign concordance 0.5126 [0.4999, 0.5252], p=0.0515 against the 50 percent chance rate, and 0.5334 p=0.0800 restricted to the top-100 genes Tahoe says moved: direction agreement is indistinguishable from chance. Median absolute delta 0.5753 L1000 vs 0.1972 Tahoe, ratio 3.31, but the two are in DIFFERENT UNITS (L1000 Level 3 normalized vs Tahoe logCPM log-fold-change) so this rules out flat L1000 deltas and is not a like-for-like effect size comparison.
